Plug-and-Play Pools - Durable and Perfect for Your Backyard

Container Pool Technical Specifications

Specification Detail
Overall Dimensions 8,000 × 2,400 × 1,500 mm
Pool Type Single-container integrated swimming pool
Structural Frame 150×150×3.5mm square tube top beam frame + 200×100×3.75mm reinforced chassis beam
Interior Surface 3mm brushed 304 stainless steel + mosaic-pattern pool liner film
Exterior Finish Galvanized corrugated steel + plastic wood (WPC) facade panels, black exterior paint
Filtration System Sand filter cylinder (quartz sand excluded) + dedicated circulation pump + ball valve network
Disinfection Automatic dosing & disinfection system (dispenser included, tablets/consumables not included)
Lighting 5× underwater atmosphere lights, waterproof low-voltage AC supply
Windows Multi-layer thickened tempered laminated glass, seaworthy fixed installation
Electrical High-power distribution box: main switch + 6-circuit breaker panel
Water Pressure Rating U-PVC supply piping rated ≥ 1 MPa
Certifications CE, ISO 9001, regional building code compliance available
Installation Method Plug-and-play; above-ground, partial burial, fully in-ground, or rooftop pools

All the features you see here can be added to your custom container pool. Contact us and share your specific needs to get your custom quote now.

Why Choose a Container Pool?

Traditional in-ground pools require weeks of excavation, extensive concrete work, and large construction crews. A container pool gives you swimming in a fraction of the time and cost:

• Speed: Most units are prefab production and can be installed in a single day on-site.

• Flexibility: Install above ground, partially buried, or fully in-ground — any orientation works.

• Portability: Engineered to ISO standards; relocate with a standard flatbed truck if your plans change.

• Sustainability: Built from container steel, reducing material waste compared to traditional construction. 

• Cost-Effectiveness: Factory-controlled quality means lower labor costs; all systems are pre-tested before shipping.

Who Suits a Container Pool?

This container pool for sale is used across a wide range of residential, hospitality, and commercial applications:

• Residential Home Backyards: Ideal for rural homes where traditional pools are impractical, such as urban and suburban households.

• Hotels and Resorts: Serve as high-end aquatic facilities for boutique hotels, campgrounds, and beach resorts.

• Fitness and Wellness Centers: Commercial gyms or rehabilitation centers can use cost-effective container pools for swimming training or physical therapy.

• Airbnb and Vacation Rentals: Hosts can attract more guests by adding unique container pool facilities.

• Event Venues: Provide temporary or semi-permanent container pool facilities for festivals, outdoor events, and brand promotion activities.

• Schools and Community Centers: Offer affordable swimming lessons without the need to build permanent pool facilities.

Whether you build a modular container pool for personal or commercial use, we will design a space as unique as you are. Contact our sales team with your project requirements for a tailored quotation.

Container Pool Design and Layout

Single-Container Pools: Compact, freestanding pools suitable for small yards, ideal for swimming training or leisurely relaxation.

Multi-Container Pools: Create large swimming pools in L-shapes, rectangles, or custom shapes by connecting two or more containers.

Above-Ground Pools: Installed on a patio or raised platform to create an infinity pool with a striking visual effect.

Semi-buried Pools: Partially buried underground, these pools blend naturally with the surrounding landscape, resembling traditional in-ground pools.

Rooftop Pools: Transform your rooftop into a resort-style leisure space and enjoy spectacular views. [Note: Structural engineering assessment required.]

What Upgrade Options for Container Pools?

Terrace: Add wood composites or other materials for relaxation and access.

Glass Windows: Install underwater viewing windows for a modern touch.

Lighting: Install LED light strips or spotlights around the pool for convenient nighttime use.

Water Features: Add waterfalls or fountains for a resort-like atmosphere.

Pull-out Jet Systems: Install a counter-current system to enhance the swimming experience.

Hot Tub: Incorporating a hot tub into the pool design enables you to enjoy your container pool year-round.

Pool Multipurpose Room: Create a separate container for a changing room, storage room, or bar/entertainment center using a freestanding container.

Pull-in Cover: Standard aluminum foil roll-up cover for easy maintenance and to keep the pool clean.

Filtration and Heating: Install filtration, heating, and pH monitoring systems to ensure efficient operation.

Frequently Asked Questions

1
Do I need a permit to install a container pool?
Permit requirements vary by city, county, and state/province. We recommend consulting your local building department before purchasing. Our team can provide documentation to support your permit application.
2
How much does a container pool cost?
Container pool pricing depends on size, configuration, and selected upgrades. Contact us for a personalized quote.
3
How long does installation take?
Most container pool installations are completed in 1 to 3 days once site preparation is done. This is faster than the 6–12 weeks typically required for a concrete pool.
4
What groundwork is required for a container pool?
Container pools can be installed above ground, partially buried, or fully buried, offering great flexibility in design and site integration. Above-ground installation is the quickest and most economical option, while buried or partially buried installations require special reinforcement to withstand soil pressure and proper waterproofing to prevent corrosion.
5
Can a modular container pool be relocated?
Yes, a portable container pool allows you to move or reposition the pool on your property; it can be lifted with a crane and transported.
6
Are container swimming pools safe?
All modular container pools include corrosion-resistant steel construction, non-slip liner options, compliant filtration and sanitation systems, and optional safety covers.
7
Is the container pool suitable for cold climates?
The 304 stainless steel shell and robust external steel structure allow it to withstand cold climates well. For year-round use in freezing conditions, we recommend installing an optional built-in pool heater (electric or heat pump) — available as a factory-installed upgrade.
8
What maintenance does a container pool require?
Daily maintenance is similar to that of any residential pool: regularly backwashing the sand filter, monitoring and adding disinfectant, and occasionally cleaning the skimmer basket. Compared to fiberglass or concrete, we specifically chose stainless steel and WPC materials to minimize long-term maintenance.
